title: FPGA Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
summary:

Our cutting-edge technology is used by tier-1 financial institutions to monitor and execute trades rapidly and efficiently. As we continue to innovate and grow, we're searching for forward-thinking FPGA Interns to help us build the future of capital markets infrastructure.
>
As an FPGA Engineering Intern at HPR, you will:
>
Build on your strong academic background as you help us advance our high-performance computing and electronic trading systems
>
Collaborate with mentors to solve real-world problems
>
Own a project through the entire FPGA development life cycle
>
Develop tools to automate RTL and testbench generation
>

>
Pursuing a BS/MS in Computer Engineering , Electrical Engineering , Computer Science , or related field and have attained Sophomore standing or higher
>
Successful completion or enrollment in relevant coursework such as Digital Logic Design, Computer Organization, or Embedded Systems
>
Must have and maintain at least a 3.0 cumulative GPA , if on a 4.0 scale
>
Required Qualifications
>
Internship or academic experience writing Verilog/SystemVerilog or VHDL
>
Familiarity working in a Linux environment
>
Proficiency with a scripting and/or high-level software language (e.g., Python, Perl, or similar)
>
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
>
Preferred Qualifications
>
Experience working with FPGAs
>
Familiarity with FPGA tools (Vivado and/or Quartus)
>
Compensation: In compliance with Massachusetts law, the anticipated hourly rate this position is $42.00/hour. title: Inference Server - Product Software Intern (Oct 2026 start)
summary:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.
>
>
At Tenstorrent, we believe the future of computing must be open, which is why our interns don't just watch from the sidelines - they help build the core of it. We provide a "code-to-career" pipeline where students collaborate with industry experts to solve high-stakes problems in RISC-V and AI hardware-software co-design. By joining us, you are taking an internship to democratize high-performance computers that are accessible to everyone.
>
Join our Inference Server Technologies team, where we build the software layer that powers state-of-the-art AI inference on Tenstorrent hardware. This team develops APIs, deploys workloads, and benchmarks end-to-end model performance so developers can efficiently scale inference on our stack. You will work on a project under the guidance of experienced engineers and a dedicated mentor. We are looking for a minimum of 3 months for this role with the potential for extension to 6 months.
>
This role is hybrid based in Belgrade, Serbia. This role starts October 2026.

Final-year BSc or MSc student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

title: Physical Design Intern - CPU/AI Hardware
summary:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. >
> Join a team shaping the performance of next-gen CPUs and AI/ML chips. As a Physical Design Intern, you'll work hands-on from synthesis through tapeout, collaborating with top engineers to optimize some of the most advanced silicon in the world.
>
This role is onsite, based out of Austin, TX or Santa Clara, CA.
>
>
Who You Are
>
Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in EE, ECE, CE, or CS
>
Solid understanding of logic design, VLSI, and transistor-level concepts
>
Familiar with PnR tools, timing analysis, and power optimization techniques
>
Comfortable scripting in Tcl, Perl, Shell, or Python
>
What We Need
>
Support key physical design tasks-synthesis, floorplanning, PnR, clocking, timing closure
>
Analyze and improve design PPA (Power, Performance, Area)
>
Collaborate with front-end, PD, and architecture teams to influence early design decisions
>
Explore and implement new flows, tools, or RTL experiments to optimize designs
>
What You Will Learn
>
End-to-end physical design flow-from RTL handoff to final tapeout
>
Deep dive into timing, power, EM/IR, and area trade-offs
>
Industry-standard tools and techniques for modern chip development
>
How top-tier silicon teams operate at scale
>
>
